title: Export bandit configuration and traces
description: You inspect the single-run JSON and multi-run array archive.

steps.description: You create artifacts and collect names, probabilities, rewards, costs, prior outcomes, and T. Array-to-list conversions prepare these configuration values for JSON.
You add cumulative rewards and choices for each result label. np.cumsum converts each reward sequence to its running total.

steps.question: Which file holds the labeled single-run choice sequences?
steps.answer: bandit_single_run.json receives single_trace, including each label's choices. The NPZ file receives the cum_rewards arrays separately.

steps.description: You write the JSON and save labels with the multi-run cumulative reward arrays. The recording lists bandit_single_run.json and bandit_multirun_cum_rewards.npz.
